candidates.title: Large-Signal Properties in MnZn Ferrites: Code and Data (N87 permittivity/conductivity and large-signal permeability)
candidates.version: GitHub main dd06889876ca7d360ae3c4cf6da6c507ba5fef2c; Zenodo v2 zip md5:9fedd293bca9e28bd2877789989bd4f3 (3,978,793 B)
measurement_types: small-signal permittivity and conductivity vs f
large-signal permittivity/conductivity vs f and E-field
permittivity/conductivity vs temperature

small-signal complex permeability (TDK datasheet)

candidates.title: Core characterization data set: loss, permeability and permittivity (Nabih 'magneto' MS Access database)
candidates.publisher: GitHub asalahnabih (Ahmed Nabih, Virginia Tech CPES)
candidates.redistribution: permitted (MIT; CITATION.cff asks to cite; related paper IEEE Xplore arnumber 10149511)
measurement_types: sinusoidal core loss Pv vs Bm per frequency
complex permeability vs f
complex permittivity vs f
candidates.data_class: experimental (mostly own measurements; ML91S characteristics 'measured by Proterial'; DMR96A permeability 'from datasheet')
candidates.reason: This is the 'Nabih Magneto' source: MIT-licensed, MHz-range sinusoidal loss for 8 high-frequency MnZn ferrites plus complex mu/eps. Small (75 loss tests, 429 Bm-Pv points). Requires an Access reader (Jackcess/mdbtools; python access-parser 0.0.x fails on this ACE file). Exclude the DMR96A datasheet permeability and flag ML91S characteristics as third-party (Proterial) measurements. Orphan rows with empty CID (402 permeability, 607 permittivity) and the 'Paste Errors' table must be dropped.
